dedupe_keys.name: hid historical irrigation dataset of area equipped for irrigation 1900 2005

description: The Historical Irrigation Dataset gives the temporal development of the area equipped for irrigation from 1900 to 2005 at 5 arc-minute resolution, published with a 2015 article in Hydrology and Earth System Sciences. The authors collected sub-national irrigation statistics and found global irrigated area rose from 63 million ha in 1900 to 111 million ha in 1950 and 306 million ha in 2005. They built eight gridded versions by combining the statistics with different historical cropland and pasture data sets under rules that favour consistency with either the statistics or the land use data, and checked the patterns against historical maps of the western United States around 1900 and a global map around 1960. Coverage is global. Access is free as a 303 MB download bundle on MyGeoHub, version 1.0 of March 2015, under CC0. Caveats: the series ends in 2005, and users must choose among the eight versions, which differ by the land use data used. Simulation uses: historical irrigation demand for long hydrological and water balance simulations and for studying growth of irrigation infrastructure. Related records: the groundwater irrigation inventory (data-global-groundwater-irrigation-inventory-siebert-2010) and the FAO Global Map of Irrigation Areas (data-fao-global-map-of-irrigation-areas).
